posts.post:
the guy at the coffee shop who looks like he put zero effort in, yet somehow looks better than everyone else in the room. 

that's the only look that actually lasts.

the guys who wear dress shoes with jeans on a sunday morning. 

i don't know what you're trying to prove, but it’s distracting.

nothing kills a morning like reaching for a shirt only to realize you forgot to steam it. 

it’s going to be a long day.

i spent all afternoon arguing with the cutter about a two-millimeter difference on the hem. 

he thinks i'm crazy. i think he's wrong.
